corrections.name: Pressure Sign

corrections.reason: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 page explicitly identifies Pressure Sign as a Strike Super Attack with 100 Ki and also places it in the Counter Skills category. Counter behavior is separate from the canonical skill class/subcategory.

notes: All Clear and Bluff Kamehameha were absent from docs/data/skills.json. Pressure Sign existed with the invalid Counter/Counter canonical taxonomy and is formally corrected while preserving its counter behavior as a separate property/category.
